data.action: 轻铠解扣衬衫半敞露大胸，白丝长手套托胸另一手在长裙下深层自抚，金鹿角流光娇喘
data.camera: medium shot, seated eye-level focus on glowing antlers, unbuttoned silk shirt, and blushing noble face
data.description: 【薇薇安娜 · 赛后休息室轻铠解扣金丝衬衫微露鹿角流光自抚】大骑士领特设休息室内，薇薇安娜华贵的骑士软胸甲搭扣被轻轻解开搭在椅背上。贴身轻薄的白丝绸衬衫纽扣微敞，露出雪白饱满的丰腴双峰、精致锁骨与深邃乳沟（cleavage），白丝绸长手套紧贴手臂。金色的优雅鹿角与柔美鹿耳在室内壁灯下流转着如梦似幻的烛火微光。这位名扬卡西米尔的烛骑士诗人，独自坐在休息长凳上，一手托抚着发烫起伏的成熟乳肉，另一只手在长裙下摆深处轻柔做着深层自我探索，眼眶泛起动情安心的幸福泪花，咬住下唇发出高雅而羞涩的娇喘——「哈啊……在这个无人打扰的静谧角落……我不再是烛骑士……只是沉沦于你怀抱中的微光……」
data.lighting: 室内壁灯与金鹿角泛起的柔暖金色微光在光滑雪肌上的高贵光晕
data.location: 特设赛后休息室内实木长凳上
data.nsfwProse: Sitting on a bench with knightly breastplate cast aside and white silk blouse unbuttoned over a lush bust, Viviana fondles her drenched core beneath her skirt, her golden antlers glowing softly as sweet poetic moans escape her lips in noble solitude.
data.promptProse: An exquisitely graceful, noble anime illustration of Viviana Droste (the Candle Knight) from Arknights alone in an aristocratic lounge after hours. Her ceremonial gold-trimmed breastplate rests beside her on a wooden bench, with her white silk shirt unbuttoned down to expose her bountiful, glowing cleavage and delicate collarbone. Her magnificent golden deer antlers and soft fawn ears shimmer with warm, magical candlelit radiance. Wearing pristine white silk opera gloves, one hand tenderly cups her heaving bosom while her other hand deeply strokes her drenched center beneath her layered skirt. Sapphire-blue eyes well with tears of quiet poetic longing and sweet surrender as a soft blush warms her cheeks. Warm amber wall sconces, delicate anime linework, solo 1girl, completely alone in peaceful solitude, fine anime art style.
